items.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%

items.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
items.description: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

items.title: Inside the high-stakes battle between digital dollars and Swift's massive money engine
items.description: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

items.title: The next trillion-dollar currency may not be a stablecoin — it might not even have a name yet
items.description: AI agents are coming. They will need to pay each other. Crypto executives agree on the problem but disagree sharply on the solution, and one thinks the answer has not been invented yet.

items.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows
items.description: When you strip out what was never mobile, correct for who's holding what and why, add back what works off-contract, the utilization of tokenized assets looks close to 20%, argues Katana’s Matthew Fisher.

items.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million worth of coins
items.description: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

items.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
items.description: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

items.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
items.description: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

items.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
items.description: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

items.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse

items.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
items.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.

items.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
items.description: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

items.title: K, C or E? Why economists can’t agree on the shape of today’s economy
items.description: Economists have long viewed the post-pandemic economy as "K"-shaped. That consensus has now evaporated.

items.title: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
